verdict.rationale: Notte documents watching sessions live: sessions return a ViewerUrl for live viewing, and the site advertises 'Live View & Replays' with screenshare and session playback. Nothing documents a human taking over control mid-run when the agent is stuck. The CDP/Playwright endpoint is a developer building block, not a takeover feature. missing for 10: documented human takeover/interactive control of a running agent session, hands-on or independent corroboration of live view.
